The map is creatively designed to spell out the word "MARRY" using yellow lines that appear to be GPS coordinates. The man is wearing a teal jacket and a black beanie, and he has a smile on his face, suggesting a positive and joyful mood. The text overlay on the image reads: "DO YOU KNOW? A Japanese man traveled 7163.7 km to create a GPS drawing to propose to his girlfriend. He made the world's largest GPS drawing
